title: Opening a Menu From the Battle Scene

posts.author: A_Higher_Plane
posts.body: So in RPG Maker MV, I have often added a command to the battle screen to open SkottyTV's STV Bestiary plugin, but after I return to battle, it messes up the battle. I think that the battle resets to the beginning (it calls Battle Start). Do you know how I can fix this?

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body: calling a separate scene while in the battle scene will do that once you return. you can try either creating that plugin's windows within the battle scene and add the necessary bestiary scene functions to the battle scene, or you can take a look at how yanfly pulled it off with his change battle equip plugin as that one does do the required prep to call a scene during the battle scene and go back.

posts.author: A_Higher_Plane
posts.body: @robrowhat do you mean by your first example?

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
if you created the plugin's windows along the rest of the battle scene's windows and then added the required functions to make them work to the battle scene, then youd be able to call the "bestiary menu" during battle without needing to go to a separate scene.
youll likely have to make a number of adjustments to make everything work properly, but itd work.
